second_run.head: a2bd82bcd174cd1af84c9d4bb49b98f13a599e05
second_run.named_by: the annotation of the new CI step, read through the public API

cause: a defect of the new test, not of the product: the check accepted any non-empty alert, and on CI the route announcer of Next.js was a second one, with the page title 'Book your appointment'
earlier_assumption: a slow CI machine ran out of time: wrong; the longer wait stays but is not the fix
first_run_cause: not read; probably the same, because the failing check does not depend on timing
fix: the two checks name the message 'The studio service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.'
why_not_seen_locally: on the development machine the announcer was empty at that moment
observation: every management screen carries the document title of the customer page, 'Book your appointment', and that is what the route announcer reads to a screen reader
